breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: volumetric flow rate in L/s is used as if it were in m^3/s.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the unit inconsistency. The original prompt used the flow rate Q=50 (in L/s) directly in the formula. The agent corrected this by explicitly stating the conversion: 'Convert the flow rate from liters per second to cubic meters per second (Q = 0.05 m³/s)'. This matches the correction made in the ground truth.
